comment: Shared by the TypeScript test (server/test/staff-metrics.test.ts) and the Kotlin test
(core/src/jvmTest/.../StaffMetricsParityTest.kt). Generated from an independent reference, then frozen.
ROUNDING: roundHalfUp(x) = floor(x + 0.5) in both languages (never banker's rounding). round2(x) = roundHalfUp(x * 100) / 100.
dailyInputs and every number in teamOverview except counts, percents and readiness are round2; readiness, teamReadiness and percent are whole numbers.
A day is a calendar day (YYYY-MM-DD) in the given IANA zone. Sleep belongs to the day its session ENDS; sessions under 60 minutes are not sleep.
mood and energy must be in 1..10, cognitive score in 0..100 (CognitiveScoring clamps it to 0..100, so cog needs no normalising), kcal >= 0; others are skipped.
Absent keys and null are the same thing for dailyInputs/teamOverview objects; null inside arrays means 'no data that day'.
teamOverview: the 7-day window is today and the 6 days before it; the previous week is the 7 days before that.
